main_text.p: in unum Carthagini convenissent calendis septembribus episcopi plu-rimi ex provinciâ Africâ, Numidi-ca, Mauritania, cum presbyteris & diaconis, præsente etiā plebis ma-ximâ parte, & lectæ essent literę Ju-bajani &c.

2. De superioritate non minus testatur historia ecclesiastica, & docet, quòd, quoties cunque de religione inciderunt controversiæ, nō ab episcopis vel papa Romano, sed vel ab imperatore solo, vel adhibitis etiā aliis Christiani orbis principi-bus, cōcilia sint decreta, & disfidē-tes convocati.

Ita synodum Niceñam convoca-vit Constantinus Imperator apud Euseb.l.1.cap.6.Rufin.lib.10. Constan-tinopolitanam Theodosius Major Sozom.l.7.cap.7. Ephesinam Theo-dosius Minor Euagr.lib.1.cap.3. Chal-cedonensem, quę item fuit una ex quatuor celeberrimis Martianus. Rursus Constantinopolitanam Ju-stinianus. Similiter dicuntur s, pa-tres

page.notes: No marginal notes on this page. Left edge strip (neighbouring page) excluded. Long s rendered as plain s. Doubtful: the final word of the first paragraph ("literę") and the abbreviation "s," after "dicuntur" (read as s,). Greek and Hebrew: none.
